exercises.title: Define neighbourhoods and their filter
exercises.objective: Contain an open set containing the point and bridge to `nhds`.
success: a neighbourhood contains an open neighbourhood

exercises.title: Express convergence with neighbourhoods and Tendsto
exercises.objective: Use eventual membership and identify the Mathlib formulation.
success: convergence is eventual membership in every neighbourhood
Mathlib convergence is Tendsto atTop nhds

exercises.title: Exhibit non-unique Sierpiński limits
exercises.objective: Verify that constant true converges to both Boolean points.
success: the dual-limit sequence is constant true

exercises.title: Connect discrete limits and Hausdorff uniqueness
exercises.objective: Use singleton neighbourhoods for eventual equality and Hausdorffness for uniqueness.
success: convergence is eventual membership in every neighbourhood

checks.lean:
example (u : ℕ → Bool) (x : Bool) (h : T15.MyConverges (LeanCraftGame.Topology.discrete Bool) u x) : ∃ N, ∀ n ≥ N, u n = x := by
  obtain ⟨N, hN⟩ := h {x} ⟨{x}, trivial, rfl, Set.Subset.rfl⟩
  exact ⟨N, hN⟩
checks.message: Convergence in discrete Bool must imply eventual equality to the limit.

checks.lean:
example : T15.MyConverges LeanCraftGame.Topology.sierpinski T15.dualLimitSequence true := by
  intro s hs
  obtain ⟨U, hU, htU, hUs⟩ := hs
  refine ⟨0, fun n hn => ?_⟩
  simpa [T15.dualLimitSequence] using hUs htU
checks.message: Constant true converges trivially to true: every neighbourhood of true contains true.

checks.lean:
example : T15.MyConverges LeanCraftGame.Topology.sierpinski T15.dualLimitSequence false := by
  intro s hs
  obtain ⟨U, hU, hfU, hUs⟩ := hs
  rw [LeanCraftGame.Topology.sierpinski_isOpen_iff] at hU
  rcases hU with rfl | rfl | rfl
  · simp at hfU
  · simp at hfU
  · exact ⟨0, fun n hn => hUs (Set.mem_univ (T15.dualLimitSequence n))⟩
checks.message: Constant true also converges to false: any open set containing false must be `univ`.
The two Sierpiński limits are genuinely distinct.

checks.lean: example {α : Type*} [TopologicalSpace α] [T2Space α] (u : ℕ → α) (x y : α) (hx : Filter.Tendsto u Filter.atTop (nhds x)) (hy : Filter.Tendsto u Filter.atTop (nhds y)) : x = y := tendsto_nhds_unique hx hy
checks.message: Mathlib's Hausdorff uniqueness theorem applies to sequence limits at `atTop`, which is nontrivial.

hints.hint: Use `∃ U, τ.IsOpen U ∧ x ∈ U ∧ U ⊆ s`; `s` itself need not be open.
Use `∀ s, IsNeighbourhood τ x s → ∃ N, ∀ n ≥ N, u n ∈ s`.
Use `Filter.Tendsto u Filter.atTop (nhds x)`; `NeighbourhoodFilter` is simply `nhds x`.
Use `fun _ => true`. Every open set containing false is `univ`, so false is a second limit.
